title: Swatch
summary: A colour or design-token sample with its resolved value and a WCAG AA contrast label against a comparison colour.

props.name: token
props.description: A CSS custom property to sample, for example "--color-accent"; resolved against this element's computed style. Takes precedence over value.

props.name: value
props.description: A literal colour to sample when token is not set, for example "#4e93e3"; useful for showing what a literal would look like (the scorecard and docs tooling, for example).

props.name: compare
props.description: A token or literal colour the swatch is contrasted against; a token is resolved the same way as token. Defaults to the page background.

props.name: large
props.description: Grade against the WCAG AA large-text threshold (3:1) instead of normal text (4.5:1).

parts.name: info
parts.description: The wrapper around the value, ratio and grade text.

parts.name: ratio
parts.description: The measured contrast ratio, such as "4.63:1".

cssProperties.name: --pk-swatch-size
cssProperties.description: The swatch box's width and height.

a11y: The swatch box is decorative (aria-hidden); the resolved value, the ratio and the pass/fail grade are all text, so the result never depends on colour alone.

examples.title: A token against the page background
